name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Private six-control Evidence Lane with optional Git intake, explicit steer lineage, tolerant HIL intent, exact-APPROVE Fuse, and user-timed fresh-host State Travel.

interface.shortDescription: Run six governed controls over universal evidence brains.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane exposes Boot, Rollback, Build, Refresh, Mode, and Source Intake after root /evi. Boot atomically verifies locked ENV15/UOP15 Flash and routes durable local versus configured remote storage fail-closed. Source Intake auto-detects all eighteen lanes and Project Engulf, offers AUTO/REQUIRED/DISABLED Git history enrichment, and always includes Chat Lineage; Mode accepts ordered known intersections and explicit custom schemas. Initial prompts and detectable mid-turn steers append as distinct secret-redacted events. Natural HIL intent is classified without promotion, while exact APPROVE alone invokes Fuse. A sealed handoff makes State Travel eligible, but it runs only on explicit user request or genuine host-context exhaustion.
defaultPrompt: Run /evi, atomically Boot plus locked ENV/UOP Flash, and show the six controls.
Use /evi-source-intake with ordered sources and auto-detection or exact lane overrides.
Use /evi-refresh to seal an unaccepted candidate, show six-way HIL, and wait for my exact decision.
